# TheWrkShop

> TheWrkShop is a Christian men's discipleship and formation ministry that serves men online. It helps men face "the wound beneath the wound": the battle that starts inside a man before it shows up at work, at home or in the rooms he leads. Its central idea is that the battle starts before the behavior, so formation has to happen upstream, in what a man believes in the moment.

TheWrkShop publishes The Daily (a short Scripture-based devotional every weekday), leadership studies for anyone who leads (managers, coaches, pastors and parents), a weekend 4-3-2-1 post, and practical tools for men's groups. Content is written from a Christian perspective and quotes Scripture (usually the NIV).

## Start here

- [The Upstream Formation Framework](https://thewrkshop.com/upstream/): A teaching model (trigger, interpretation, agreement, response, formation) for how what a man believes in the moment shapes who he becomes. Includes Scripture, a worked example, a worksheet and a Q&A. It is a proposed teaching model, not a neurological claim or a quotation of Scripture.
- [The Daily](https://thewrkshop.com/daily.html): Today's devotional. One Scripture, one hard question and one step, released at 12:01 am Central on weekdays.
- [Leadership & Culture](https://thewrkshop.com/leadership/): Studies on how leaders shape culture: what they reward, tolerate and model, and how they respond to disagreement, success and the need to be liked.
- [Get Known](https://thewrkshop.com/get-known.html): For men who want to join an online group. A short form followed by a 20-minute phone call or Google Meet.

## Resources

- [Questions Men Ask](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/): Short, Scripture-based answers to questions men search for, each with practical steps: [How do I start a men's group?](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/how-to-start-a-mens-group/), [How do I control my anger as a Christian man?](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/how-to-control-anger-as-a-christian-man/), [How do I stop needing other people's approval?](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/how-to-stop-needing-approval/), [Why do I keep falling into the same sin?](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/why-do-i-keep-falling-into-the-same-sin/), [What's the difference between conviction and condemnation?](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/conviction-vs-condemnation/), [How do I quit porn for good as a Christian man?](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/how-to-quit-porn-as-a-christian-man/), [How do I stop worrying and actually give it to God?](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/how-to-stop-worrying-and-trust-god/), [What is my purpose as a man?](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/what-is-my-purpose-as-a-man/), [Why do I feel so alone, even with people around me?](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/why-do-i-feel-so-alone/), [Why do I feel empty even when life is going well?](https://thewrkshop.com/questions/why-do-i-feel-empty/).
- [Free Infographics](https://thewrkshop.com/infographics/): Shareable images of TheWrkShop's frameworks: the Upstream Formation Framework, the Information Funnel, "Every Leader Trains the Room," "Whatever You Celebrate, They Will Copy" and more. Free to share with credit and a link.
- [The Pattern Finder](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/pattern-finder/): A free 3–5 minute reflection that points to one of six recurring response patterns and gives a 7-day practice. Answers stay in the browser. Not a diagnosis.
- [Pattern Practice Library](https://thewrkshop.com/patterns/): Six response patterns with real-life examples, reflection questions, 7-day practices and biblical insight: [The Protector](https://thewrkshop.com/patterns/protector/) (defensiveness), [The Controller](https://thewrkshop.com/patterns/controller/) (control), [The Pleaser](https://thewrkshop.com/patterns/pleaser/) (approval), [The Avoider](https://thewrkshop.com/patterns/avoider/) (avoidance), [The Prover](https://thewrkshop.com/patterns/prover/) (performance and worth), [The Reactor](https://thewrkshop.com/patterns/reactor/) (anger).
- [The Pattern Interruption Lab](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/interruption-lab/): An interactive rehearsal of a tense moment that ends in a printable practice card.
- [The Growth Journal](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/growth-journal/): A private journal for difficult moments (what happened, the story I told myself, my response, what I will practice) with a seven-day review. Entries stay in the browser.
- [Men's Group Starter Kit](https://thewrkshop.com/sub-pages/resources/starter-kit.html): A weekly rhythm, a first-four-weeks plan, a discussion flow and free printable PDFs (meeting agenda, reading plan, accountability pairs guide, group covenant, facilitator one-pager).
- [Spiritual Gifts Assessment](https://thewrkshop.com/assessment.html): A free assessment of spiritual gifts and likely ministry fit.
- [The One Verse Man](https://thewrkshop.com/one-verse-man/): Hub for "Don't Miss Your Verse," with a small-group facilitator guide.
- [Are You Missing Your Moments?](https://thewrkshop.com/one-verse-man/diagnostic/): A free, private biblical self-reflection (35 questions across 7 areas: pace and presence, attention, pride, fear, comfort, honesty and repentance, dependence on God). Answers stay in the browser. A reflection aid, not a clinical test.
- [Prayer Formation: Go Deeper Than the Request](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/): Free prayer resources in TheWrkShop's Daily voice: five foundation articles ([What Is Biblical Prayer?](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/what-is-biblical-prayer/), [What Do I Do After I Give It to God?](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/after-you-give-it-to-god/), [When God Seems Silent](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/when-god-seems-silent/), [How Do I Know What to Pray For?](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/how-do-i-know-what-to-pray-for/), [When Waiting Begins to Define You](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/when-waiting-begins-to-define-you/)), a [Prayer Pattern Finder](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/pattern-finder/), a [Surrender Tool](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/surrender/), a [guided prayer](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/guided-prayer/), [seven days of prayer](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/7-day/) and a [six-session group guide](https://thewrkshop.com/prayer/for-groups/). Answers stay in the browser. A reflection aid, not a diagnosis.
- [After the Amen: Trusting God After You Pray](https://thewrkshop.com/after-the-amen/): A free interactive reflection on what happens between the prayer you pray and the life you live afterward: a branching Decision Lab (family, work, medical care), an eight-question reflection, eight Scripture pathways, an editable prayer, a seven-day journey and a 45-minute group guide. Answers stay in the browser. A reflection aid, not a clinical or spiritual assessment.
- [The Belief Project: I Believe. Help My Unbelief.](https://thewrkshop.com/belief/): Free resources built on Mark 9:24 for any church group or individual: [Belief Under Pressure](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/belief-under-pressure/) (24 questions across six themes: uncertainty, disappointment, control, approval, obedience, prayer), [The Hidden Trust Diagnostic](https://thewrkshop.com/belief/trust-diagnostic/), [Belief and Practice](https://thewrkshop.com/belief/belief-and-practice/), a [guided prayer](https://thewrkshop.com/belief/prayer/), a [seven-day path](https://thewrkshop.com/belief/7-day/) and a [six-session group guide](https://thewrkshop.com/belief/group-guide/). Answers stay in the browser. A reflection aid, not a clinical or spiritual test.
- [What’s Feeding It? A Private Self-Check on Lust](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/what-feeds-it/): A free, private self-check for Christian men (24 statements across six root systems: the eyes and imagination, pain and pressure, loneliness and the love deficit, boredom and no mission, identity and pride, drift and weak defenses, plus the situations when temptation hits), with Scripture, guardrails and a seven-day path. Answers stay in the browser. A reflection aid, not a clinical assessment.
- [Steward or Owner? A Private Reflection on Control and Trust](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/steward-or-owner/): A free, private reflection (15 owner-vs-steward choices across five lenses: trust, identity, fear, surrender and mercy; the Reflex Test; and a five-step Stewardship Shift on one specific burden), built on Matthew 25:14-30 and Proverbs 3:5-6, with a seven-day practice and a group guide. Answers stay in the browser. A reflection aid, not a clinical assessment.
- [The Filter Lens: What’s Been Shaping the Way You See?](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/filter-lens/): A free, private reflection (Movement One: Recognize). Ten questions on inherited assumptions, unexamined beliefs, past-trained expectations, attention, normalized patterns, approval, private habits, responses to change, repeating cycles and what God might reveal (Psalm 139:23–24, Romans 12:2). Each question has Scripture, a second-layer follow-up that suggests a related question, prayer, a listening prompt and one next step; then an Awareness Audit (discard, submit, embrace), a printable journal with a seven-day review and a Daily Filter Reset. Answers stay in the browser. A reflection aid, not a clinical assessment.
- [Group Studies](https://thewrkshop.com/studies/): Free, ready-to-run men’s Bible studies, each with a leader guide and a printable handout. [The Reflex vs. the Response](https://thewrkshop.com/studies/reflex-vs-response/) (Luke 6:45): what comes out of you first under pressure, with a 60–90 minute leader guide, breakout questions, the 3-Second Reflex Interrupt and a 7-day Reflex Journal. [The Doing vs. the Dwelling](https://thewrkshop.com/studies/doing-vs-dwelling/) (John 15): an eight-session study on why many men are busy for God but rarely with Him (activity vs. abiding, service vs. surrender, ministry vs. the Master, fruit vs. effort, performance vs. presence, assignment vs. attachment, work vs. walk, sending vs. staying), with the Return practice, a weekly log, room activities and a tap-through quick check in every session.
- [What’s in Your Hand? A Private Purpose Inventory](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/whats-in-your-hand/): A free, private five-step inventory built on the biblical pattern of God asking “What do you have?” (Moses’ staff, the widow’s oil, the loaves and fish): take stock of skills, resources, training, voice, story, scars, relationships and availability; name the excuse; then open your hands, with a seven-day path and a group guide. Versions for [after a loss](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/whats-in-your-hand/#after-loss), [veterans](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/whats-in-your-hand/#veterans), [young men](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/whats-in-your-hand/#young-men) and [couples](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/whats-in-your-hand/#couples). Answers stay in the browser.
- [What’s Really First? The Kingdom First Diagnostic](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/kingdom-first/): A free, private Matthew 6:33 reflection (24 questions across six areas: authority and surrender, security and control, approval and identity, desire and attachment, righteousness and motives, trust and daily obedience, plus 6 real-life scenarios), with Scripture, a seven-day practice and a group guide. Answers stay in the browser. A reflection aid, not a clinical or spiritual test.
- [The Unexamined Heart](https://thewrkshop.com/tools/unexamined-heart/): A free, private 2 Kings 5 reflection (18 statements across six areas: expectations and control, anger, defensiveness, integrity, desire, prayer and obedience; 4 real-life scenarios; an Agreement Finder; a guided prayer; a seven-day path) with a four-session group guide. Answers stay in the browser. A reflection aid, not a clinical or spiritual test.
- [Resources](https://thewrkshop.com/resources.html): Bible study tools, habit trackers and reading plans.
